【原视频简介】
I spent over $5,000 testing GPT-6 Astra and comparing it directly against Fable 5.1 and the differences were bigger than I expected. I tested both models on a complex 3D build, frontend development with and without a Figma reference and a real feature inside an existing production codebase. Along the way, I compared code quality, speed, cost, tool use, verification, and how agentic each model actually feels in a real workflow. GPT-6 surprised me in a lot of areas, but Fable 5.1 still has some very clear strengths.
